answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 1333 Country: India Title: My sister who is 4 years married is tortured emotionally,mentally by her husband & Inlaws.Her husband is unemployed from 3&1/2 years.He doesn't seems to be reformed when we try to settle.My sister says I will not go to his house otherwise I will suicide.Husband refuse to give Talaq.Can she take "khula".We don't want to go Court.Can u suggest any Darul Qaza in UP(near Aligarh) & DELHI.How much time it will take & what will happen if her husband doesn't come by sermon from Darul Qaza. Question: My sister who is 4 years married is tortured emotionally,mentally by her husband & Inlaws.Her husband is unemployed from 3&1/2 years.He doesn't seems to be reformed when we try to settle.My sister says I will not go to his house otherwise I will suicide.Husband refuse to give Talaq.Can she take "khula".We don't want to go Court.Can u suggest any Darul Qaza in UP(near Aligarh) & DELHI.How much time it will take & what will happen if her husband doesn't come by sermon from Darul Qaza. Answer ID: 1333 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1187/915=H) The consent of husband is compulsory for khula . It is suggested to reconcile and settle the matter with the mediation of some eminent persons. Madrasa Aminia Delhi and Jamia Khadimul Islam Bulandh Shahar Road , Hapur have Sharai Panchayat system. But, how much time it will take, it is difficult to predict. We can not decide any thing beforehand for the husband if he fails to abide by the order of the Sharai Panchayat. Please, go there yourself or write a letter to them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
